diagnosis.root_cause: Oversized-decode decompression bomb payload (asset a91f declaring 48000x48000 px from a 40KB file) combined with aggressive client retries (140 times) pinned the CPU on the image-resizer service and exhausted the workers.
evidence: image-resizer CPU utilization surged from ~39% to ~100% starting at 19:32 UTC
2026-12-01T19:32:00Z image-resizer ERROR decode job for asset a91f exceeded 60s; image declares 48000x48000 px from a 40KB file
2026-12-01T19:35:00Z image-resizer CRITICAL all workers busy on oversized-decode jobs; resize queue depth 9000; CPU pinned
2026-12-01T19:37:00Z image-resizer WARN asset a91f resubmitted 140 times (client retry)
diagnosis.recommended_fix: Keep the blocklist active for malicious or malformed assets like a91f, ensure the newly added max-decoded-dimension guard is permanently enforced across all image processing workers to reject decompression bombs early, and implement rate limiting or exponential backoff on client retries to prevent retry amplification.
